method: MOE schools from moe-schools-geocoded-derived.csv with match_quality exact or ambiguous, located at OneMap SVY21 X/Y, kept when within 2000 m of the Queenstown planning-area polygon (st_buffer 2000 m, planar). in_queenstown flags points inside the polygon; dist_to_qt_boundary_m is 0 inside. Subset of MOE columns kept (school_name, address, postal_code, mainlevel_code, type_code, nature_code, session_code, zone_code, dgp_code).
purpose: School locations for school assignment of Queenstown children.
